product.name: Velora SilkGlow 2-in-1 Hair Serum
product.description: Velora SilkGlow 2-in-1 Hair Serum delivers a lightweight, nourishing treatment for all hair types. The compact 200‑ml bottle combines organic argan oil, vitamin E, and a silicone‑free formula to smooth frizz and add shine without weighing hair down. A dual‑function nozzle delivers precise application, while the glass bottle preserves freshness and protects the active ingredients. The amber cap protects from light exposure, extending shelf life. Ideal for daily use, it can be applied before styling or as a finishing touch after washing. The serum is free from sulfates, parabens, and synthetic fragrances, making it suitable for sensitive scalps and color‑treated hair.
